_doc: Shared random-item affix pool, armor side (generated from docs/plans drafts 2026-10-02). price_melee/price_caster = centi-M (100 = one item measure), the generator reads the killer's archetype column. items/slots/tier as in weapon_affixes.json; tier = best-tier floor (1 legendary only .. 4 uncommon+). Weapons keep weapon_affixes.json until they move to M. Stats with 'unit' scale in measure rolls (getMeasure: level / slot factor): value = unit * rolls. ac unit is an estimate (AC is weak, Kit). Tier caps for M-priced items: weapon_tiers max_affixes_m (distinct affixes, stacks count once) and max_negatives_m.

_weapons._doc: Weapons on the M budget (docs/plans/weapons-on-m.md). use_m: WeaponGenerator rolls from this file instead of weapon_affixes.json. Two-handedness is decided before the name and the affixes: weapon_classes requires two_hands = always, else the class two_hand_chance percent, else never; the name is then drawn among the two-handed names (or any not forbidding it) or the one-handed ones; a two-hander gets base ave/damroll and the tier M window x two_hand_k and one more affix. flag: price_by_level centi-M interpolated by item level (clamped to the end points), same for both archetypes; a flag is allowed on the cheapest tier whose max_m covers its price (and not below min_tier); dearer than the legendary window = never rolled. affects_by_tier: dynamic_price, priced at roll time from the calculator step at the item level. weapon_tier: a tier floor that applies to weapons only (damroll/hitroll stats: rare and up).
